rows.ARS:
Dark red Mini-Flora.
Registration name: WEKamrav
Exhibition name: Valentine's Day™
rows.Origin:
Bred by Tom Carruth (United States, before 2002).
Introduced in United States by Weeks Wholesale Rose Grower, Inc. in 2006.
Introduced in United States by Bailey Nurseries in 2011 as 'Valentine's Day'.
rows.Bloom: Dark red. Mild fragrance. 25 to 36 petals. Average diameter 2.25". Medium, full (26-40 petals), cluster-flowered, cupped, globular bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Tall, climbing, well-branched. Medium, semi-glossy, medium green foliage. 3 to 7 leaflets.

Height: 6' to 10' (185 to 305cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 10b. Can be used for garden.
rows.Patents:

This invention relates to a new and distinct variety of Climbing Rose. It has as its seed parent the variety known as `MEIcauf` (U.S. Plant Pat. No. 7,718) and as its pollen parent the variety known as `FRYtrooper` (U.S. Plant Pat. No. 9,211) .... description is of 3 to 4 year-old rose plants of the new variety grown outdoors in Upland, Calif. in the month of October.
